# Design point P017

## Description

A proxy forwards each Git push to multiple repository replicas, whose storage can be managed through replaceable JGit repository-storage interfaces while preserving Git operations. The service can mark a node advisory-offline after approximately three consecutive failed operations, affecting subsequent routing or maintenance; no explicit write-acknowledgment or refusal behavior is specified.
